text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! Come and dance with me! 
Hold! Aaand lift!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And I'll be there with the silver and
gold confetti! It's 
going to be a stage you can be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Oi, calm down!
I think you two are getting a little bit
carried 
away thanks to the excitement of the live
performance!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, excitement,
huh? If it can still be felt once one
steps 
off of the stage… the anniversary live
performance carried a 
great amount of meaning in it,
wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I agree. I heard that despite the distance,
people from my hometown also watched it.
They seemed grateful for it and I 
received a lot of messages about it
afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The performance was so amazing, 
it made so many people happy. Therefore,
let's eat and celebrate 
to our hearts content, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… Haha, of course! Ah… However,
I'd like to ask that you 
at least put the food onto a plate,
Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Oi.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's Brian-san♪ What is it?
Impressed with 
my performance? Which of my songs was it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"ENDLESS DREAM!!" maybe? 
Brian-san's, "BLAZE" was also…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Wrong… You need to eat more meat.
If all you eat is sweets and 
snacks, you won't build up any muscle.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ueee! You're acting like this during the
afterparty!? 
Brian-san,
you're acting too much like your usual
self!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
…What lies at the end of our races,
what lies at the end of our 
matches is live performances. Therefore,
I see no issue with 
continuing to train whenever a chance presents
itself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Okay everyone,
I would like to congratulate 
you all for the amazing anniversary live
performances 
and the excellent afterparty.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your words of encouragement,
President, however… 
the manager of the track notified me that
"one of the students 
that was meant to be at the party was instead
training".

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
More importantly… Brian. 
Why was it your name that came up?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha! It's fine,
don't worry about it. I was going 
to tell her that she was free to do whatever
she 
wanted after the performance anyways.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
After all,
the autumn GI season is about to start… She
was 
likely just preparing for the future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The curtain has finally closed on a
spectacular stage,
filled to the brim with glitter and
cheers. 
What comes next is more exciting races!
